profile_text.body:
CrowdStrike is a publicly traded global cybersecurity company (NASDAQ: CRWD, CIK 0001535527) that describes itself as an AI-native cybersecurity leader. Its core offering is the Falcon Platform, a cloud-native system designed to protect endpoints, cloud workloads, identities, and data. The company's site positions the platform as addressing AI-powered threats, cloud breaches, and the securing of AI systems themselves, including AI model scanning and an AI security dashboard.

The company's tracked AI product is CrowdStrike Charlotte AI, categorized under Security and Identity AI. It is described as focused on security operations, threat detection, autonomous response, and high-privilege access management. CrowdStrike's site frames Charlotte AI as part of its broader effort to counter adversaries who use AI to accelerate attacks.

No litigation or MCP server entries are recorded in the held facts for CrowdStrike at this time.
